Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding electronic filing of reports to the legislature and the governor.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to filing reports electronically to the legislatureand the governor; and adding a new section to chapter 43.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) All reports required to be submitted to the legislatureshall be provided only in an electronic format. Reports must besubmitted electronically to the chief clerk of the house ofrepresentatives and the secretary of the senate. The chief clerk ofthe house of representatives and the secretary of the senate shallprovide an online site for reports submitted to the legislature on thelegislative internet home page. The reports shall be organized in sucha way as to make the reports easy to find and accessible bylegislators, staff, and the public. (b) Upon electronic submittal of the required report to the chiefclerk of the house of representatives and the secretary of the senate,the agency shall send a letter, also by electronic means, to theappropriate legislative committee that the report has been filed. The p. 1 HB 1753letter may include a brief summary of the report. The public entitysubmitting the report may make hard copies available by request. (2)(a) All annual and biennial reports to the governor shall beprovided only in an electronic format. The governor shall provide anonline site for reports on the governor's official state web site. Thereports shall be organized in such a way as to make the reports easy tofind and accessible by the public. (b) Upon electronic submittal of the required report to thegovernor's office, the agency shall send a letter, also by electronicmeans, that the report has been filed. The letter may include a briefsummary of the report. The entity submitting the report may make hardcopies available by request.
